name: hpc
description: Run fixed scientific benchmarks and independently verify their saved evidence. Local CPU references are separate from unavailable Slurm/OpenFOAM execution.

writes.name: benchmark-step
writes.description: Read benchmarks and runs first to obtain their current specDigest. Supply that returned specDigest when executing run, verify or cancel. Execute only a fixed available local reference, independently verify saved evidence, cancel a local run or compare runs with the same specification. Inputs and verification thresholds are frozen. Does not provision compute resources, change thresholds, or submit Slurm/OpenFOAM jobs.
